mentions.name: pxv
mentions.description: pxv is a simple image viewer inspired by John Bradley's xv, keeping most of the same ergonomics while being easy to run on any machine with a single 'uv run' command.
mentions.problem: xv is paid shareware that can't be installed via package managers like apt, so it is rarely available across the author's machines.
